get_model_config: get the AlphaFoldConfig dataclass for a named model like model_1 or model_3_ptm
model_config: get the ml_collections ConfigDict for a named AlphaFold model such as model_5_multimer_v3
CONFIG_DIFFS: inspect the CONFIG_DIFFS dict to see per-model config patches for monomer and multimer variants
MODEL_PRESETS: list available model preset groups like monomer, monomer_ptm, and multimer with their model names
AlphaFoldConfig: review the AlphaFoldConfig dataclass and nested config classes to understand model architecture parameters
